description: This file defines a PHP class Startup within the Opencart admin marketplace controller namespace. It handles HTTP requests related to startup management, including listing, enabling, disabling, and deleting startup entries, by interacting with models and rendering views. It also manages session data, permissions, and routing.

classes.name: Startup
classes.description: Controller class managing the startup-related administrative functionalities for the Opencart marketplace, including listing, status toggling, and deletion of startup entries.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the startup management page, loads necessary language files, sets page title, prepares breadcrumb navigation, and renders the startup list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the request to list startups, responds with a rendered startup list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates the list of startups with pagination, fetching data from the startup model, and returns the rendered list view.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected startups by updating their status in the database, with permission checks.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected startups in the database, with permission verification.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected startups from the database, ensuring user has appropriate permissions.
